evals.prompt: I have 6 profile screens in Figma (node IDs: 540:9301, 540:9372, 687:6107, 540:9464, 540:9559, 540:9823). File key is ZTrCM0RDRJQT4m2xGzKEBR. Decompose all screens, map to our ui-native components, and figure out what needs building.
evals.expected_output: Creates collab/figma-swarm/profile/ structure, spawns 6 screen agents via /cmux-agents, each produces a decomposition file, shared components are registered in component-needed.md with consensus protocol

assertions.description: Invokes /cmux-agents to spawn screen agents (not sequential, parallel)
Creates collab/figma-swarm/ directory structure with component-needed.md and mailbox
Uses Figma MCP to screenshot at least one screen
Registers missing components in component-needed.md with specs
References consensus protocol for shared components
Does NOT build all components sequentially itself — delegates to agents

evals.prompt: Two of my screen agents both need a BottomDrawer component but with different heights. Agent-A wants 60% and Agent-B wants 40%. How do they resolve this?
evals.expected_output: Applies consensus protocol: suggests making BottomDrawer a single component with a height prop (variant consolidation). Requires 2 straight consensus loops between Agent-A and Agent-B. If they can't agree, flags to orchestrator.

assertions.description: Suggests variant consolidation (one component with height prop) rather than two separate components
Describes the claim → wait → negotiate → agree → agree again flow
Mentions escalation to orchestrator if consensus fails

evals.prompt: The designer updated 3 screens in Figma since we last mapped them. Check for drift.
evals.expected_output: Follows drift workflow: re-screenshots the 3 screens, compares against stored decompositions, produces a drift report with changes detected (new/removed/changed components)

assertions.description: Uses Figma MCP to re-screenshot screens
Compares against existing screen decomposition files
Produces a drift report with change categories (NEW/REMOVED/CHANGED)
Suggests updates to component registry based on drift
